query: MiniMax H3 generation in ComfyUI via KJNodes' MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch hard-crashes the CUDA context on SM89 (L20) inside the int8-QK/FP8-PV kernel path (_sageattn_int8_fp8_nhd); KJNodes PR #748 V-offset fix does not help.

desired.outcome: OP A/B confirmed a settings-level workaround: switch the 'Patch Sage Attention KJ' mode to sageattn_qk_int8_pv_fp16_cuda and the same workflow runs cleanly — crash is specific to the SM89 FP8-PV kernel, which remains unfixed upstream.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
